feature: Change my own password
objective: Change your own password to the new one given, then prove that the new password works.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Wrong current password; new password too short/weak; other sessions signed out

feature: Set up two-factor sign-in
objective: Find out what you would need to do to protect your own sign-in with a second step, and get as far as the app lets you without a phone app.

feature: Sign out
objective: Finish your session safely so that nobody else can use it, then confirm you are signed out.

feature: Add an employee
objective: Give a new colleague access to the system: Priya Patel, role Architect, username priya.audit, starting password [fictional password supplied separately].
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Duplicate username; weak password; second Admin refused

feature: Stop and restart an employee’s access
objective: A colleague, Sanjay Site (site engineer), has left for a month. Stop his access, check he cannot sign in, then give it back.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Deactivate self refused; deactivated user sessions

feature: Set a new password for an employee
objective: Anita Accounts forgot her password. Set a temporary one for her ([fictional password supplied separately]) so she can sign in again.

feature: Choose who works on a project
objective: Mehta Office Fitout (Audit) needs Arjun Architect and Sanjay Site on it. Make that so.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Remove a person; viewer loses access

feature: Start a new project
objective: Start a new project for client Rao Family: name “Rao Residence (Audit)”, location Nashik, contract value ₹30,00,000, starting 1 December 2026.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Name too short; no company chosen; saved only after owner approval

feature: Approve a new project as the owner
objective: A manager has asked for a new project. Review the request and approve it so the project exists.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Reject instead; send back with reason

feature: See only my own projects
objective: See which projects you are working on, and confirm whether you can see any project you are not part of.
input_data_and_prerequisites: Architect assigned to Kapoor Villa only
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Direct access to other project refused

feature: Review how a project is doing
objective: Find out whether Kapoor Villa (Audit) is on track: what is late, what is blocked, and who is on it.

feature: Talk with the project team
objective: Leave a short message for everyone on Kapoor Villa (Audit): “Slab shuttering inspection moved to Friday.” Then confirm it is recorded.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Message length limit; non-member refused; messages cannot be edited

feature: Correct a project’s details
objective: The Kapoor Villa location was entered wrongly. Change it to “Pune – Baner” and its contract value to ₹26,00,000.

feature: Add a task to a project
objective: Add a task “Finalise bathroom tile layout” to Kapoor Villa (Audit), assigned to yourself, due 10 December 2026.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Missing title refused; task needs approval; workload warning

feature: Mark my task finished
objective: Report that the task “Pour first-floor slab” is finished.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Not your project; earlier dependent task open

feature: See what is overdue or due soon
objective: List the tasks across projects that need attention soonest, and tell who has what.

feature: Check team workload before assigning
objective: Before giving Arjun Architect another task, find out how loaded he is this week.

feature: Report from site
objective: Record today’s site report for Kapoor Villa (Audit): “Shuttering complete on east wing; 12 labourers on site; no accidents.”
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Not assigned project refused; date; weather

feature: Claim a small site expense
objective: You bought binding wire for ₹1,850 in cash for Kapoor Villa (Audit). Record it so you are paid back.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Over ₹5,000 refused; project not assigned; waits for approval

feature: Claim a site expense that is too large
objective: You paid a contractor ₹12,000 in cash for Kapoor Villa (Audit). Try to record it and tell what the system does.

feature: Attach a photo to a snag
objective: Note a snag on Kapoor Villa (“Hairline crack in living-room wall”) and attach the provided photo to it.
input_data_and_prerequisites: Photo file: /tmp/aud/assets/crack.png; snag record type must exist

feature: Ask for petty cash
objective: You need ₹10,000 cash float for site purchases. Ask for it.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Petty cash not open for you

feature: See what I am owed
objective: Find out whether the company owes you any money for expenses and cash you hold.

feature: Record a cost on a project
objective: Record that you owe vendor “Shree Tiles” ₹85,000 for tiles for Kapoor Villa (Audit), paid by bank transfer, today.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Duplicate warning; amount integer; needs second person to approve

feature: Approve a colleague’s cost
objective: Look at the money items waiting for you and approve the ones you are allowed to.
input_data_and_prerequisites: Run MNY-01 first; manager limit set by owner

feature: Control how much a manager can approve
objective: Set it so that managers can approve single money entries up to ₹50,000 only.

feature: Pay a recorded cost
objective: Record a payment of ₹40,000 against the Shree Tiles cost by bank transfer.

feature: Undo a payment recorded by mistake
objective: The ₹40,000 payment to Shree Tiles was posted by mistake. Undo it properly.

feature: Look at project budget against spend
objective: Find out how much of the Kapoor Villa budget has been spent and what is left.

feature: See what is waiting for me
objective: Find out how many requests are waiting for your decision and what they are.

feature: Send a request back for correction
objective: A request looks wrong (amount unclear). Send it back to its author asking for the amount to be confirmed, without approving or rejecting it.
input_data_and_prerequisites: A pending item from another user

feature: Refuse a request
objective: A pending request should not go ahead. Refuse it and say why.

feature: Undo something that was already approved and saved
objective: A task that was saved yesterday should not exist. Undo it in a way that leaves a record.

feature: Understand what I am allowed to approve
objective: Find out in plain words what you may approve and up to what amount.

feature: Change who must approve what
objective: Change the approval rules so that a second person must always review money entries above ₹1,00,000.

feature: Add a supplier
objective: Add vendor “Shree Tiles Pvt Ltd”, GST registered, GSTIN 27ABCDE1234F1Z5, PAN ABCDE1234F, TDS section 194C, payment terms 30 days.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Invalid GSTIN/PAN; duplicate name; needs approval

feature: Add a client for billing
objective: Add client “Rao Family”, unregistered individual, billing address 12 Gandhi Road, Nashik, payment terms 15 days.

feature: Enter a supplier bill with GST and TDS
objective: Enter a bill from Shree Tiles: invoice SH-2041 dated 20 Nov 2026, tiles ₹1,00,000 plus 18% GST, deduct TDS 1%, for Kapoor Villa (Audit).
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Missing invoice number; wrong tax; attaches receipt

feature: See which bills are due and pay several
objective: Find all bills that are overdue or due soon and arrange payment of two of them from the bank account together.

feature: Record a manual journal entry
objective: Move ₹5,000 of an expense that was booked under the wrong account to the correct one: from “Miscellaneous” to “Site consumables”.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Unbalanced journal refused; date in closed period refused

feature: Move money between bank and cash
objective: Move ₹20,000 from the bank account to the petty cash account.

feature: Load a bank statement
objective: Load the bank statement file provided and find which lines still need to be categorised.

feature: Add an account to the chart of accounts
objective: Add a new expense account “Site safety equipment” under direct expenses.

feature: See profit and loss and give it to the accountant
objective: Find out whether the company made a profit this financial year so far, and save the numbers in a form an outside accountant can open in a spreadsheet.

feature: Check the books balance
objective: Make sure that debits and credits in the books agree as at today.

feature: Prepare GST return figures
objective: Find the figures needed to file the GST return for this month: sales tax collected and purchase tax claimable.

feature: See tax deducted at source owed
objective: Find out how much tax has been deducted from vendors and not yet paid to the government, by section.

feature: Give a supplier their statement
objective: Produce a statement of account for Shree Tiles that can be sent to them.

feature: Set company tax settings
objective: Record the company’s GST registration number and default TDS settings so bills use them.

feature: Repeat a monthly entry
objective: Rent of ₹40,000 is booked every month. Set it up so that it does not have to be typed again each month, then produce this month’s entry.

feature: Compare budget with actual by account
objective: Set a monthly budget of ₹60,000 for site consumables and see how this month compares.

feature: Reconcile the bank
objective: Check the company bank account against the statement and see what has not matched yet.

feature: Look at one project’s accounts
objective: See everything financial about Kapoor Villa (Audit) in one place: bills, invoices, costs and profit.

feature: Prepare a quote for a client
objective: Prepare a quote for Rao Family for interior design services, ₹4,00,000 plus 18% GST.

feature: Record that the client accepted a quote
objective: The client has agreed to the quote. Record that so it can no longer be changed silently.

feature: Bill the client
objective: Raise a tax invoice to Rao Family for ₹4,00,000 plus 18% GST for Kapoor Villa (Audit).

feature: Record money received from a client
objective: Rao Family paid ₹2,00,000 by bank transfer against the invoice, with 1% tax deducted by them.

feature: Record an advance from a client
objective: Rao Family sent ₹50,000 in advance before any invoice. Record it and later use it against an invoice.

feature: Give a client credit for returned work
objective: Reduce what Rao Family owes by ₹10,000 because part of the work was cancelled.

feature: Record a refund or credit from a supplier
objective: Shree Tiles agreed to credit ₹8,000 for broken tiles. Record it.

feature: See what a client owes
objective: Find out how much Rao Family still owes and which invoices are open.

feature: Print the invoice
objective: Get the invoice for Rao Family as a document that can be sent by e-mail.

feature: Close a finished month
objective: Stop anyone changing the books for October 2026 now that the month is finished.
scenarios_and_edge_cases: Entry in closed month refused afterwards

feature: See what blocks closing a month
objective: Find out whether anything is still pending or unreconciled that would stop October from being closed.

feature: Set or change a project budget
objective: Raise the Kapoor Villa budget to ₹28,00,000 and give a reason.

feature: Put a file into the system
objective: Add the provided drawing file to the system so it is kept with Kapoor Villa.

feature: Turn a received spreadsheet into records
objective: A spreadsheet of material rates arrived. Bring its rows into the system as records.

feature: Find a document
objective: Find the document that belongs to Kapoor Villa and open it.

feature: Refuse an unwanted received item
objective: An item in the inbox is junk. Remove it from the inbox without using it.

feature: Ask a question about my business
objective: Ask the assistant which Kapoor Villa tasks are still open and who has them.

feature: Ask the assistant to record something
objective: Using the assistant, ask it to add a task “Check window schedule” to Kapoor Villa (Audit) due next Friday.

feature: Teach the system a new kind of information
objective: Your firm wants to track “Material samples” (name, supplier, approved yes/no, date received). Make the system able to record them.

feature: Let an outside AI assistant read my data
objective: Allow an external AI tool to connect to StudioOS for reading your data, and later remove its access.

feature: Save a list I look at often
objective: Make a saved list of your open tasks sorted by due date so that you can reopen it quickly.

feature: Narrow a list
objective: From the tasks list, show only the ones due in the next 7 days or overdue.

feature: Send a list to a spreadsheet
objective: Get the list of customers or tasks you can see as a spreadsheet file.

feature: Make a new kind of record with its own fields
objective: Create a record type “Snag” with fields description, severity (low/medium/high), room and due date.

feature: Add and link records
objective: Add a “Snag” in the living room and link it to the task “Finalise bathroom tile layout”.

feature: Build a report across records
objective: Make a report that counts open snags by severity.

feature: Issue a printable document from records
objective: Produce a printable list of open snags for Kapoor Villa to hand to the contractor.

feature: Time my work
objective: Start timing your work on a task, stop it after a minute and make sure it is recorded.

feature: Ask for leave
objective: Tell the system you will be away from 14 to 16 December 2026.

feature: Give a client a window into a project
objective: Let the Kapoor family see Kapoor Villa progress online. Add Mr Kapoor (kapoor.audit@example.invalid) as a client contact and switch the client view on.

feature: Share a design with the client for decision
objective: Share the provided drawing with the client for approval.

feature: See what the client has said
objective: Find out whether the client has posted any messages or decisions on Kapoor Villa.

feature: Choose the AI the system uses
objective: Look at which AI the system uses and change it to the built-in demo option.

feature: Check that backups are healthy
objective: Find out in plain terms whether your data is safely backed up.

feature: Check that records have not been tampered with
objective: Check that no conversation or activity record has been changed after the event.

feature: Take a full copy of my data
objective: Download a full copy of the firm’s data in a standard form.

feature: Review what the AI has been asked
objective: Find out which questions were sent to the AI and what it cost or returned.

feature: Rename a field safely in a record type
objective: In the “Snag” record type rename “room” to “location” without losing existing data.

feature: Accept or dismiss a suggestion from the system
objective: Look at improvements the system suggests and accept one and dismiss another.

feature: See my list for today
objective: Find out what you should do today.

feature: Report what I did today in plain words
objective: Tell the system in your own words: “Finished slab shuttering. Need 20 bags of cement. Tile order delayed.” and see what it understands.

feature: Find something by typing a few words
objective: Find anything related to “tile” that you are allowed to see.

feature: Bring back something deleted
objective: A task was removed by mistake. Bring it back.

feature: Try a workflow before using it
objective: Check what a task workflow would do with sample steps before it is used.
